beats.text: If your API key is in your frontend, it's public.
Your dot env has a key, with a public prefix.
Build it, and the key is copied into the bundle.
Search in dev tools. There it is, in plain text.
Anyone can. Minifying doesn't hide it.
Keep the key on your server. The browser asks your server, and your server calls the API.
Follow DevAegis, to protect your code.
